cacophony: Kakos + phone: bad sound. A cacophony of car horns.
cathartic: Katharsis: cleansing. Crying at the film felt cathartic.
caustic: Kaustikos: burning. Caustic soda; caustic wit.
cloying: Cloy: clog with sweetness. Cloying perfume.
debacle: Débâcle: breakup of river ice. A total debacle.
discern: Dis + cernere: sift apart. Discern the truth.
discordant: Dis + cor: hearts apart. A discordant note.
discredit: Dis + credit: undo trust. Discredit the witness.
discrepancy: Dis + crepare: sound different. A discrepancy in the accounts.
disparage: Dis + parage (rank): lower. Disparage a rival.
divulge: Di + vulgus: tell the crowd. Divulge a secret.
euphemism: Eu + phemi: speak well. “Passed away” is a euphemism.
florid: Flos: flower. A florid style; a florid complexion.
flout: Flout: scoff at. Flout the law.
heterogeneous: Heteros + genos: other kinds. A heterogeneous crowd.
hierarchy: Hieros + arkhe: sacred rule. Corporate hierarchy.
hyperbole: Hyper + ballein: throw beyond. “Million times” is hyperbole.
incorporate: In + corpus: into a body. Incorporate comments.
indelible: In + delere: can’t erase. An indelible mark.
indifferent: Not different enough: also so-so. An indifferent meal.
indolent: In + dolere: no pain, no effort. An indolent afternoon.
neophyte: Neo + phyton: new plant. A neophyte skier.
orthodox: Ortho + doxa: right opinion. Orthodox views.
permeate: Per + meare: pass through. Smoke permeated the room.
pervasive: Per + vadere: go through. Pervasive corruption.
precursor: Pre + currere: runs before. A precursor of the internet.
proliferate: Proles + ferre: bear offspring. Rumours proliferate.
propensity: Pro + pendere: lean forward. A propensity to worry.
recant: Re + cantare: sing again, take back. Recant testimony.
stigma: Stigma: brand mark. The stigma of illness.
subjugate: Sub + jugum: under the yoke. Subjugate a people.
subside: Sub + sidere: settle down. The flood subsided.
succinct: Succinctus: girded up. A succinct summary.
supersede: Super + sedere: sit above. Supersede the old rules.
surmise: Sur + mettre: put on. I surmise he left.
table: Table: US postpone, UK propose. Table the motion.
watershed: Water + shed: divide. A watershed election.
winnow: Winnow: fan the grain. Winnow the list.
